english.title: Port manager fail take steps re embarkation of passengers in designated control area
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person concerned in the management of a port, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORT..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to take any steps required by Schedule 2 to the Immigration Act 1971 in relation to the embarkation of passengers where a control area was designated.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(c) of the Immigration Act 1971.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Rheolwr porthladd yn methu cymryd camau parthed teithwyr yn byrddio mewn man rheoli dynodedig
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn a oedd yn ymwneud â rheoli porthladd, sef **(..SPECIFY THE PORT..),heb esgus rhesymol, bu i chi fethu cymryd camau sy'n ofynnol gan Atodlen 2 Deddf Mewnfudo 1971 mewn perthynas â theithwyr yn byrddio lle'r oedd man rheoli wedi'i ddynodi.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
